doc: Every number is {v: value, u: SI unit, l: provenance label, s: source}. Labels: MEASURED-K (measured from the A9 CAD), DERIVED (computed from labelled inputs), SYNTHETIC_UNVALIDATED (declared engineering assumption), MANUFACTURER (published figure, often for a different machine), REGULATORY_REFERENCE. Positions are in the CAD frame = MuJoCo body frame (X forward, Y = CAD-RIGHT = physical LEFT/port, Z up), at the build pose (pods road 0, legs retracted, wings deployed slide 0, pins home, hatches open, canards deployed). Variants overlay 'base' by deep merge.

revision_log.change: Initial parameter set for the live-sim build.

Adopted research_notes/Phantom CG compensation and test flights/propulsion_and_energy_components.md section 8 recommended values: fan annulus r_hub 0.110 / r_tip 0.245 m (replaces planned 0.065 / 0.25 m), FM_open 0.80, sigma 1.0, pod motor 370 kW cont / 460 kW peak / 530 N m, motor+inverter 38 kg, pod structure 25 kg, TG600-class 600 kW at 270 kg each (DERIVED estimate), generator efficiency 0.96, SFC 0.36 kg/kWh_e, spool tau 1.0 s, ramp 0.3 P/s, boosters 300 kW / 35 kg / exit area 0.0445 m2, bus 800 V, radiator 45 kW at zero airspeed, cooling fans 2 kW, accessory load, buffer chemistry 182 Wh/kg, buffer T limit 333.15 K, body Cd 0.32.
Flight-test research (flight_test_methods.md): added attitude + vertical-speed FBW mode, PTI generator, crash ring buffer, pilot-loop timing and logging channels per section 3 table.
phantom-fx set to research s9 FX-A; FX-A/FX-C load states added; take-off generator rating parameters added.

CG study adopted: hover pitch trim from front/rear pod thrust differential only; leg load-cell CG go/no-go gate; P3 (booster vector-down) and P5 (1.5x canard with flap) as proposal parameters, off by default. Nose battery: CG study N2 (193 kg P50B at x 1.24) recorded as alternative; phantom-fx keeps the propulsion-sized FX-A buffer (311 kg at x 1.80) per coordinator reconcile instruction; CG recomputed by the ledger (fx base CG x -0.151).

A10 corrected wing cassette is now the main Phantom configuration: phantom and phantom-fx use A10. The A9 cassette stays selectable as the earlier version (phantom-a9, phantom-fx-a9). Flights before this change (incl. the 2026-11-03 campaign) were flown with A9; their recorded parameters say so. phantom-fx (FX-A A10) is the current prototype.
revision_log.basis: owner direction 2026-11-03: A10 is the main second vehicle; keep A9 explicitly as the earlier version

hull_areal_density_kg_m2.s: CFRP skin + thin core aero shell over the tub

tub_areal_density_kg_m2.s: CFRP/Nomex structural sandwich; measured closed-solid area halved to panel area

reaction_box_areal_density_kg_m2.s: rear reaction boxes, half closed area

seat_mass_kg.s: CFRP bucket seat with anchors and restraint

pod_pylon_mass_kg.s: fixed Ti bracket, pin, pylon and tilt EMA stator per pod

leg_fixed_mass_kg.s: leg cartridge + extension EMA per leg

mass_each_kg.s: repo baseline 170 kg / 2 (PHYSICS_AND_RESEARCH_BASELINE); FAA AC 120-27F ~86 kg reference

seated_cg_offset_m.s: seated torso CG relative to cushion area centroid

fan_r_tip_m.s: largest annulus inside tyre bore (research note s1)

fm_open.s: figure of merit vs open-rotor ideal P=T^1.5/sqrt(2 rho A); research s8

duct_sigma.s: exit/fan area ratio; sets wake velocity and ram-drag mass flow

zero_thrust_advance_ratio.s: J0 for C_T(J) = C_T0 (1 - J/J0), J = V_axial/(omega R)

design_speed_fraction.s: peak-power thrust reached at this fraction of the tip-speed limit (sets k_T)

motor_specific_power_w_kg.s: 460 kW / 38 kg, used to rescale motor mass in the sweep

hub_motor_rotor_mass_kg.s: traction motor rotor on the wheel

hub_motor_stator_mass_kg.s: traction motor stator in the pod

tilt_rate_rad_s.s: A8 animation timing (90 deg in 1.25 s); not an actuator rating

fan_enable_tilt_deg.s: interlock: fans only run with pod at least this far toward fan mode

rotor_spin_sense.s: +1 = counter-clockwise seen from above in fan mode; diagonals alike

fm_open.s: reproduces research s5: 2,420 N static at 300 kW on 0.0445 m2

housing_mass_kg.s: research s5 35 kg each incl. rotor

power_each_w.s: Safran TG600 class electrical rating (external machine, not selected)

positions_m.s: rear engine bay ahead of booster EDFs; third slot (fx sweep only) under the sleeve

takeoff_power_each_w.s: as drawn: no take-off rating above continuous

hv_junction_position_m.s: between TG bay and sleeve bay

accessory_power_w.s: pumps, ECS, TG accessories (research s8 25 kW incl. actuators)

tank_capacity_kg.s: each of two cells; Mission fuel_kg <= 110

reserve_kg.s: total reserve case for the CG table

radiator_rejection_static_w.s: research s5: A8 core with 2 x 0.25 m fans at zero airspeed at 60 K loop-ambient difference

radiator_rejection_ram_w_per_m_s.s: added ram-air rejection per m/s airspeed

motor_cooling_ua_w_k.s: fan-stream cooled winding at hover flow

wing_basis.s: screening = half S_ref per side (body carry-over); exposed = exposed panel only (sensitivity)

aileron_strip_area_m2.s: wing planform between aileron eta stations

flap_strip_area_m2.s: wing planform between flap eta stations

flat_plate_cn.s: flat plate normal-force coefficient at 90 deg

fin_area_each_m2.s: half of V_TAIL object surface area

body_centre_m.s: body force reference (no Munk moment modelled)

crash_force_n.s: non-gear contact force classed as collision

gear_sink_limit_m_s.s: gear limit sink rate at first contact

moment_authority_fraction.s: max differential thrust per pod as a fraction of its rated thrust (pilot + augmentation)

augmentation_authority_fraction.s: max augmentation share of rated pod thrust (rate damping / attitude loops)

vs_leak_tau_s.s: integrator leak so the mode cannot act as altitude hold

vs_authority.s: max |collective correction| around the trim estimate

leg_loadcell_cg_gate_m.s: research_notes/.../cg_and_compensation.md: pre-takeoff leg load-cell CG estimate go/no-go; max |CG x - pod centroid| vs trim authority

FX-C.s: FX-C calibration loading, recommended first hover case (research s9)

p3_booster_vector_down_total_n.s: research_notes/.../cg_and_compensation.md P3 (proposal): boosters vectored down for ~2 kN total; 0 = off

p3_booster_vector_angle_deg.s: research_notes/.../cg_and_compensation.md P3 nozzle deflection below horizontal; 0 = off

p5_canard_area_scale.s: research_notes/.../cg_and_compensation.md P5 (proposal): 1.5x canard with flap; 1.0 = off

p5_canard_flap.s: research_notes/.../cg_and_compensation.md P5 canard plain flap enabled (1) / off (0)

p6_drs_stabilator.s: P6 (proposal): DRS flap flown as an all-moving stabilator in the plant (pitch control and stability; airbrake on the brake command while rolling); 0 = off

p6_stab_position_m.s: engineering/phantom/drs_flap.py: PIVOT (hinge at 25% chord = section AC)

p6_stab_cla_per_rad.s: engineering/phantom/drs_flap.py: Helmbold slope at AR_eff 6.75 (Hoerner end-plate correction, fins as end plates)

p6_stab_alpha0_deg.s: engineering/phantom/drs_flap.py: inverted NACA 4412 zero-lift +4.0 deg + 10 mm Gurney ~+1.5 deg

p6_stab_rest_te_up_deg.s: engineering/phantom/drs_flap.py: REST_DEG (trailing edge up, downforce incidence)

p6_stab_gain_deg_per_demand.s: stabilator travel per unit FBW pitch demand (same mapping as the canards)

p6_stab_travel_deg.s: control travel about zero, trailing edge up positive

p6_stab_rate_deg_s.s: rotary EMA rate; drs_flap.py hinge moment 56 N m at 200 mph sizes a 120 N m actuator

p6_airbrake_te_up_deg.s: engineering/phantom/drs_flap.py: AIRBRAKE_DEG (deployed on the brake command while rolling above 12 m/s)

p6_stab_eta_q.s: engineering/phantom/drs_flap.py: ETA_Q dynamic-pressure ratio at the flap (deck/cabin wake)

p7_booster_engine.s: P7 (proposal): boosters replaced by turbine engines (0 = EDF boosters, 1 = 4 x PBS TJ150, 2 = 1 x Williams FJ33-5A)

p7_tj150_mass_kg.s: PBS TJ150 weight 18.9 kg (pbs.cz TJ150 page)

p7_tj150_sfc_kg_per_n_h.s: PBS brochures 0.116-0.119 kg/N/h at max thrust (mid value)

p7_tj150_t90_s.s: PBS brochure: sibling TJ80 idle to max rpm < 5 s; no TJ150 figure published

p7_tj150_jet_velocity_m_s.s: momentum lapse T = T0 (1 - V/Vj); typical small-turbojet specific thrust ~700 N s/kg (ram compression neglected: conservative)

p7_tj150_count.s: P7 option 1: four engines, two per booster station

p7_fj33_thrust_n.s: Williams FJ33-5A max thrust 1,846 lbf = 8.21 kN (Wikipedia, FJ33); Flaris release ~8.5 kN

p7_fj33_mass_kg.s: Williams FJ33-5A dry weight ~130 kg (Flaris release; Wikipedia < 140 kg)

p7_fj33_sfc_kg_per_n_h.s: FJ33 SFC 13.8 g/(kN s) = 0.0497 kg/(N h) (Wikipedia, at 1,200 lbf)

p7_fj33_t90_s.s: 14 CFR 33.73(b): flight idle to 95% rated take-off thrust in <= 5 s (used as t90)

p7_fj33_jet_velocity_m_s.s: momentum lapse T = T0 (1 - V/Vj) for a small turbofan; ~25% lapse at M0.28

p7_installation_mass_factor.s: mounts, nozzle, fuel system and fire protection over dry engine mass

p7_idle_thrust_fraction.s: idle thrust when throttle > 0 (throttle 0 = engines off)

p8_wing_incidence_deg.s: P8 (proposal): wing cassette mounted at a positive geometric incidence so the wing lifts without rotating the body on its wheels (CAD change to the cassette mount); 0 = as drawn

phantom.description: As drawn: two 600 kW turbogenerators, ~12 kWh buffer in the centre floor bay, avionics under the console, fuel cells in the under-sleeve bay, A8-size wheel fans. Main Phantom configuration: A10 corrected (level) wing cassette.

phantom-fx.description: CURRENT PROTOTYPE (Phantom FX-A A10). FX-A feasibility design point (research s9, owner direction 2026-11-03): ~1,915 kg, Ø1.10 m fan-wheels with Ø0.90 m fans (2.36 m2 total), FM 0.90 with deployable 10 deg diffuser, TG900-TO (900 kW_e <=5 min, 600 kW_e cont), 311 kg Amprius-class buffer in the nose at x 1.80, avionics x 1.70, fuel in the tub centre bay at x -0.06, mass-reduction set R. Pod pivots moved to y +/-1.25 to clear the sill in VTOL pose. Every change is a DESIGN PROPOSAL, SYNTHETIC_UNVALIDATED. Main Phantom configuration: A10 corrected (level) wing cassette.
design_proposals: Ø1.10 m fan-wheels, Ø0.90 m fans, 2.36 m2 total disk (appearance cost: largest; fenders redrawn)
Pod pivots y +/-1.04 -> +/-1.25 (packaging: clear the body sill in VTOL pose)
TG900-TO single turbogenerator (900 kW_e <=5 min, 600 kW_e cont); induction area ~2x A9
311 kg Amprius-class buffer in nose bay at x 1.80; avionics x 1.70 (owner approved CG fix)
Fuel 129 kg in tub centre bay at x -0.06 (owner approved)
Mass-reduction set R (structure, legs, HV, interior, avionics)
Alternative (not active): CG study N2 nose battery 193 kg P50B at x 1.24 against front bulkhead, radiator moved forward, 18 kg avionics; mount design load ~53 kN forward

hinge_y_m.s: packaging: pivots outboard to clear the sill with Ø1.1 m pods

hinge_z_m.s: wheel centre for Ø1.10 m wheel, 0.06 m road clearance kept

fan_r_hub_m.s: hub giving 0.59 m2 per pod (2.36 m2 total)

pod_structure_mass_kg.s: pod allowance 190 kg / 4 minus wheel, rotor, hub motor, brake

hv_junction_mass_kg.s: HV distribution incl. 3.5 m runs to the aft TG

tank_capacity_kg.s: 129 kg total; needs ~0.06 m3 beyond the 0.101 m3 bay

phantom-a9.description: EARLIER VERSION: A9 wing cassette (wings stacked at different heights, 118 mm stagger; slide stroke 1.37 m). Kept for comparison with earlier flights; superseded by A10. Otherwise as phantom.

phantom-fx-a9.description: EARLIER VERSION: A9 wing cassette (wings stacked at different heights, 118 mm stagger; slide stroke 1.37 m). Kept for comparison with earlier flights; superseded by A10. Otherwise as phantom-fx.
